notes.title: Version v1.01 Released
notes.content:
Hi everyone, just a quick post to let you know we uploaded a new build earlier this week.  Version 1.01 is a minor update to correct a few things, the main change was fixing some of the puzzles based on player feedback.  It was possible to complete a few of the levels without using all the pieces, so even though you could still finish the puzzles in the standard way, we felt this should be fixed.  Thanks to all our players for the feedback, and a special mention for Mark Alan who gave us a lot of useful information.

FIXED: Players could complete some levels without using all the tiles
ADDED: Title screen now displays the version number!
